title: Canonical quotient tower augmentation commutes with pullback
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subset A$ an ideal and $f:Y\to X$ a morphism of small sites. For $T=X,Y$ let $a_T:\Delta_T\to\mathcal R_T$ be the quotient augmentation, the transpose under the constant-tower/derived-limit adjunction of the completion unit $\eta_T$ [lem-sp-completion-mate-comparison]. Then for every $M\in D(Y,A)$, $f^{*,J}(a_{Y,M})$ followed by the reduction/pullback comparison equals the constant/pullback comparison followed by $a_{X,f^*M}$.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 0B56, 0941 and 099M; split from completed projection coherence proof

proof.text: Choose a flat-term K-flat representative $P$ of $M$ [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]; its diagonal is K-flat because tensoring an acyclic tower is acyclic at every index [lem-weil-tower-category-levelwise-abelian]. In each degree the ordinary quotient augmentation sends $m$ to $1\otimes m$, and the defining insertion equation of the strict module reduction/pullback comparison of [lem-sp-completion-mate-comparison] says that pulling back this map and then applying the comparison equals the augmentation after pullback, at every index and compatibly with transitions. Apply this termwise to $P$ and localize; the normalized derived reduction/pullback comparison identifies the reduced complexes. The completion-unit formula and the normalized constant-tower/derived-limit adjunction identify the adjunct of the localized augmentation with the unit, so it is $a_T$. Naturality transports the equality to every $M$.

lean.statement:
theorem quotientAugmentation_pullback (f : Morphism Y X) (M : Y.derived A) :
    (f.towerPull A).map ((Y.quotientAugmentation A I).app M) ≫
        (f.reductionPullIso A I).hom.app M =
      (f.constantPullIso A).hom.app M ≫
        (X.quotientAugmentation A I).app ((f.pull A).obj M)
